野化放归的大熊猫，为什么"教"它独立生活那么难？

Why is it so hard to "teach" a captive panda to live wild again?

野外生存需要识别天敌、找食、避险和领地行为，圈养个体缺乏这些学习机会；放归前要循序渐进地"去人类化"和野化训练，否则难以存活。
Wild life needs recognizing predators, foraging, avoiding danger and holding territory—skills captive pandas never learn. Pre-release "de-humanizing" and rewilding training are essential, or survival fails.

竹林"集体开花"为什么会威胁大熊猫？

Why does mass bamboo flowering threaten giant pandas?

许多竹子按固定周期（有的几十年一次）同步开花后成片枯死，大熊猫主食骤减；这种周期性"断粮"让本就稀疏的种群更脆弱。
Many bamboos flower synchronously on fixed cycles (some every few decades) then die back, suddenly cutting the panda's main food; this periodic "famine" makes an already sparse population more fragile.

大熊猫从"濒危"降为"易危"，说明了什么？

What does the giant panda's downlisting from "Endangered" to "Vulnerable" show?

说明栖息地保护、人工繁育和生态廊道建设起了作用，种群止跌回升；但它仍受威胁，降级不等于"安全毕业"，保护不能松劲。
It shows habitat protection, captive breeding and corridors worked and populations rebounded; but threats remain, so downlisting is not "graduation"—protection must continue.

保护大熊猫，为什么常常"顺带"救了一整片森林的邻居？

Why does protecting giant pandas often save their forest neighbors too?

因为大熊猫需要的大片连片竹林和森林，也是许多其他动植物的家；守住它的家园，就等于撑开一把"大伞"罩住了无数邻居。
The large connected bamboo forests pandas need are also home to many other species; protecting their home opens a big "umbrella" that shelters countless neighbors.
